	try([1,2,3,4.0,5.0,6.0,7.0].sum()),
	try([1.0,2.0,3.0,4,5,6,7].sum()),

	try(sum([1.0,2.0,3.0,"four",5.0,6.0,7.0])),

	try(sum([])),
]
